calls.score_scale: 60 of 90 assessable points, shown as a percentage
calls.formula: score = round(100 x points earned / assessable maximum); a component whose source is not loaded is excluded from the maximum, not counted as zero

components.rule: 20 points if any authorization is loaded; +10 more if any is a De Novo grant
product-linked completed interventional studies: 10 points for 1 or more, +10 more for 3 or more; +10 if any is randomized; +10 if any product-linked study has results posted

not_assessable.reason: US sources are loaded as a census; EU is exact lookups of known names only, and UK and Swiss sources are not loaded

interpretation_limits: a stated convention for comparing documented evidence, not a predictive model or a valuation
US sources only; absence of EU, UK or Swiss data lowers nothing and proves nothing
